title: Cryo-EM structure of a methanogen nitrogenase–PII protein supercomplex
title_zh: 甲烷古菌氮化酶–PII蛋白超级复合物的冷冻电镜结构
abstract: Nitrogenases are metalloenzymes that catalyse the reduction of atmospheric dinitrogen to ammonia, sustaining the global nitrogen cycle1,2. Although bacterial nitrogenase has been extensively characterized, the architecture and regulation of archaeal nitrogenases have remained unknown despite longstanding evidence of nitrogen fixation in methanogens. Here we report a cryo-electron microscopy structure of a native nitrogenase–PII protein supercomplex from Methanosarcina acetivorans. The structure reveals an assembly of three NifDK heterotetramers bridged by six NifI1,2 heterotrimeric PII complexes, which sterically block NifH association and lock the enzyme in an inactive state. The PII complexes show asymmetric binding of ADP and 2-oxoglutarate, coupling nitrogenase inhibition directly to cellular energy and nitrogen status. Addition of 2-oxoglutarate and ATP releases the NifI complexes, stimulating a threefold increase in NifDK activity in vitro. This higher-order architecture identifies a regulatory strategy in methanogens in which PII proteins drive nitrogenase oligomerization to control activity. The finding that nitrogenase activity may be modulated through direct assembly into higher-order structures indicates future directions for the exploration of nitrogenase evolution, regulation and biotechnological applications. Cryo-electron microscopy of a nitrogenase supercomplex from a methane-producing archaeon reveals a mechanism in which PII proteins drive assembly of such structures to regulate nitrogenase activity in response to nitrogen availability.
abstract_zh: 氮化酶是催化大气二氮化氮还原为氨的金属酶，维持全球氮循环1,2。虽然细菌氮化酶已被广泛表征，但古菌氮化酶的结构和调控机制尽管有大量甲烷菌固氮证据，却一直未知。本研究报告了甲烷沼气酚甲烷菌原生氮化酶–PII蛋白超级复合物的冷冻电镜结构。该结构揭示了三个NifDK异源四聚体通过六个NifI1,2异源三聚体PII蛋白桥接而成，空间位阻阻止NifH结合并锁定酶处于非活性状态。PII蛋白显示出对ADP和2-α-酮戊二酸的非对称结合，将氮化酶的直接抑制与细胞能量和氮代谢状态耦合。加入2-α-酮戊二酸和ATP可释放NifI复合物，在体外刺激氮化酶活性三倍增加。这种高级别的架构确定了甲烷菌中一种调控策略，即PII蛋白驱动氮化酶寡聚化以控制活性。氮化酶活性可通过直接组装成高级别结构来调控，这表明了氮化酶进化、调控和生物技术应用的未来方向。甲烷产生古菌氮化酶超级复合物的冷冻电镜研究揭示了一种机制：PII蛋白驱动此类结构的组装，以响应氮的可用性而调控氮化酶活性。
